message.yvanchuxiuzhen.cooking.steamer.g: Place the steamer above a lit furnace or smoker, or above a campfire or fire.
Put the recipe in the slot on the right, then add the ingredients listed on it.
Put bowls, plates, large bowls and iron plates in their corresponding slots on the left.
Press the cooking button, then keep right-clicking the steamer to finish cooking.
Stack steaming baskets above the steamer to cook several dishes at once.
message.yvanchuxiuzhen.cooking.steamer.i: §4Your cooking level is too low. Try a simpler dish first.
message.yvanchuxiuzhen.cooking.steamer.c: §4Place a porcelain bowl in the first serving slot on the left!
§4Place a porcelain plate in the second serving slot on the left!
§4Place a large bowl in the third serving slot on the left!
§4Place an iron plate in the second serving slot on the left!
message.yvanchuxiuzhen.cooking.steamer.m: §4Add the ingredients required by the recipe!
§4The iron pot needs heat! Light a campfire, place a stove, or light a fire below it.
message.yvanchuxiuzhen.cooking.steamer.s: Cooking started! Keep right-clicking the iron pot to stir the ingredients.
